        return float('inf')
    
    n = len(sequence)
    # Use FFT-based convolution for better performance on large sequences

    sum_sq = sum(sequence)**2
    if sum_sq < 1e-10:
        return float('inf')
    
    c1 = 2 * n * max_conv / sum_sq
    return c1
